tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List the markets Swiftedge covers, with a link to each live order book heatmap.

tools.name: get_market_snapshot
tools.description: Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest, large trades in the last 24 hours and the USD value of measured liquidations within 1, 2, 5 and 10 % of pr

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market_snapshot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest and large trades in the last 24 hours, with links to the live heatmap on swiftedge.uk." → after: "Live order flow snapshot for one market: price, today's range (UTC), the largest order book walls within 3 % of price, resting liquidity, positioning levels (estimates), funding, open interest, large trades in the last 24 hours and the USD value of measured liquidations within 1, 2, 5 and 10 % of pr"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
